notes: Only existing third-party resources are listed. Nothing here was written or generated by the collector.
All earlier records, IDs and fields are unchanged. New fields added in the gap-filling pass: verification_status_original (the earlier status value), suitability, is_new.

verification_status now uses VERIFIED / PARTIALLY_VERIFIED / UNVERIFIED / INACCESSIBLE. PARTIALLY_VERIFIED covers FreeScienceLessons videos (title and playlist matched, not watched) and Cognito, Oak and FuseSchool video lessons (page read, playback not tested).
suitability 'weak_fit_not_counted' marks a PMT question set that is kept in the file but not counted as practice coverage because it is very small or a weak fit for the subtopic. Nothing was deleted.
One record exists per (resource, subtopic_id). A resource that spans several subtopics has one record for each.
PMT Set B whole-topic Physics papers are mapped per question: coverage.relevant_questions lists the questions that belong to the subtopic and coverage.relevant_marks their marks.
PMT does not print the exam board inside its Physics Set A/B PDFs. They are hosted in PMT's AQA folder; the board is recorded as unconfirmed in verification_notes.
meta.removed_resources_note: No resource was removed. 2 PMT set(s) flagged weak-fit were kept in the file but are not counted as practice coverage.

verification_status_meanings.VERIFIED: Page or PDF was opened and its content read.
verification_status_meanings.PARTIALLY_VERIFIED: Existence confirmed and some content checked, but the content was not fully checked (for example a YouTube video matched from its title and playlist, or a lesson page whose video could not be played).
verification_status_meanings.UNVERIFIED: Found but could not be checked.
verification_status_meanings.INACCESSIBLE: Link does not work or needs access that is not available.
